title: Siloed collector adapter and trace shim for private deploys
creator: Liam Chen
description: Problem: Private (VPC/on-prem) collector relays currently forward telemetry into shared observability pipelines without a compact per-deployment isolation layer. This increases the blast radius for misrouted traces, makes per-tenant sampling/configuration brittle, and complicates RBAC for downstream dashboards and SLO alerts. Objective: implement a lightweight collector adapter + trace shim that runs in private relays and enforces per-deployment isolation policies before telemetry enters the central pipeline. The adapter should: (1) normalize and sign envelopes for replay-safe ingestion, (2) translate/namespace trace IDs to avoid collisions across customers, (3) attach immutable tenant-silo metadata for downstream routing and policies, (4) expose per-deployment sampling and retention knobs, and (5) emit observability metrics so we can monitor isolation effectiveness and failures.
acceptance_criteria: Collector adapter retrieves tenant config (sampling, retention, signed key) from local reconciler and applies it to all outgoing envelopes
Trace IDs are translated with a reversible namespace mapping so relayed traces can be anchored for debugging without leaking original IDs across tenants
Adapter attaches X-RW-DEPLOY-SILO header and signed envelope metadata accepted by central ingest (proof-of-origin verification)
Per-deployment sampling rules are honored and are measurable in metrics (per-silo rate and backpressure counters visible in grafana)
No cross-tenant trace linking in dashboards or alert queries when isolation mode is enabled
End-to-end test harness demonstrates private relay -> central ingest path with two tenant silos and verifies isolation properties
implementation_notes: Introduce a small adapter binary in the on-prem relay image that sits between local OTEL SDK and the forwarder
Namespace translation: use a 64-bit XOR with per-deploy nonce + HMAC for reversible mapping; store nonce in reconciler config secret
Signed envelopes: sign a hash of (original_trace_id || timestamp || deploy_id) with ephemeral per-deploy key; central ingest verifies using stored public key
API: adapter exposes a /metrics endpoint with labels deploy_id, sample_rate_applied, dropped_by_policy, sign_failures
Config distribution via existing private reconciler (reuse pattern from ENG-34001 where possible) to avoid adding a new control plane surface
RBAC: dashboards should automatically filter on X-RW-DEPLOY-SILO for private deploy users; add a migration guide for tenant owners
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Spike/PoC in a test private cluster (single deploy) — feature flag off by default
Phase 1: Canary with 3 low-traffic customers, enable signed envelopes and trace translation (monitor sign_failures)
Phase 2: Gradual ramp to broader private fleet and enable automatic dashboard isolation
Phase 3: Default-on for new private deploys, upgrade path for existing deploys via reconciler rollout
observability_outputs: logs: adapter-level structured logs with fields (deploy_id, op, result, original_trace_id_hash)
test_plan: Unit tests for namespace translation and HMAC verification
Integration test: local OTEL SDK -> adapter -> forwarder -> central ingest verifies signature and reverse-translation path
SLO regression test: ensure added adapter adds <5ms p50 overhead for typical relay traffic
Chaos test: adapter key rotation during active ingestion and verifying replay safety
migration_notes: Existing private relays will be opt-in via reconciler toggle; document CLI and UI flags for customers
For clusters running very old relay images, provide a helper that performs safe drain and upgrade to avoid partial signing states
Provide a dashboard and alert to surface relays that have stale keys or failing signature verification
security_considerations: Ephemeral per-deploy keys must be stored in customer-managed KMS when available
Adapter must zero out sensitive in-memory material after key operations
Central ingest will reject unsigned envelopes when enforcement is enabled to prevent silent fallbacks
Key rotation policy: rotate every 7 days by default with a 1-hour overlap window for verification
notes_for_ops: Runbook: How to enable isolation for a specific customer (reconciler toggle -> roll relays -> verify metrics)
If sign_failures spike, fallback to accepting signed or unsigned for a short grace period and open incident
Metric thresholds: 0.1% sign_failures triggers pager after 15m sustained window
